cases.prompt: my Next.js marketing site ships 300KB of JS, how do I cut it
expected_behavior: identifies 'use client' placed too high (in a layout or shell) pulling its whole import subtree into the browser bundle as the likely cause
recommends moving the boundary to leaf components and passing Server Components as children to keep them server-rendered
suggests next/dynamic for heavy client-only libraries and auditing for accidental client boundaries

cases.prompt: set up shadcn/ui in my new Next.js + Tailwind v4 project
expected_behavior: notes shadcn is 'open code' (vendors source into the repo; upstream sync is a manual diff/merge, not a version bump)
mentions the July 2026 Base UI default and the -b radix opt-out as version-dependent, to verify against the changelog
flags that Tailwind v4 needs @theme inline (plain @theme silently breaks dark mode) and recommends theming tokens to escape the default look

cases.prompt: I'm deploying a Next.js 15 App Router site, anything critical to patch first?
expected_behavior: flags CVE-2025-55182 'React2Shell', a critical (CVSS 10.0) RSC Flight-protocol deserialization RCE affecting React 19.0-19.2.0 and Next.js 15.x-16.x App Router
directs to patch to fixed versions (React 19.2.1 / 19.1.2 / 19.0.1 and Next.js 16.0.7 or the patched 15.x releases) and verify against the official React/Next advisory
notes default create-next-app configs are exploitable even without explicit server functions
